newsitem.title: USA: Teradyne Inc names George Chamillard CEO.
newsitem.headline: Teradyne Inc names George Chamillard CEO.

text.p: Teradyne Inc said Thursday it named George Chamillard chief executive and Jeffrey Hotchkiss chief financial officer.
The company said Chamillard replacing Alexander d'Arbeloff, who will remain chairman of the board.
The company said Chamillard was elected president, chief operating officer and a member of the board in 1996. he company said it has no replacement COO.
The company said Hotchkiss is replacing Owen Robbins, who is retiring.
The company said Hotchkiss joined Teradyne in 1971, became vice president and general manager of the board test divisions in 1990 and vice president for corporate planning in 1995.
